usedFor: Shopify holds the products, and Microsoft To Do receives lists to organize tasks through “Create Task List”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Task List” in Microsoft To Do
bestTemplate.why: Each new product gets its own list, ready for launch tasks.

watchOut: “Complete a Task” marks a task done, so point it only at an event that really finishes the work.
